academics.heroSubtitle: Building strong foundations for lifelong learning.

overview.title: Our Academic Journey
overview.subtitle: From early childhood through adolescence, we guide every student toward excellence.
overview.text: MAHAD Al-TOWHEED offers a comprehensive academic curriculum spanning from Kindergarten through Grade 10. Our programs are designed to develop critical thinking, creativity, and a love for learning in every child.

levels.title: Programs by Level
levels.subtitle: Three stages of growth, one mission of excellence.

kindergarten.title: Kindergarten
kindergarten.description: Our kindergarten program focuses on early literacy, numeracy, social skills, and creative exploration through play-based learning. We create a nurturing environment where young minds develop confidence and curiosity.

primary.title: Primary Education
primary.description: The primary program builds strong foundational skills in core subjects while fostering critical thinking and problem-solving abilities. Students engage in interactive learning, group projects, and hands-on activities.

intermediate.title: Intermediate Education
intermediate.description: Our intermediate program prepares students for higher education with advanced coursework, independent research skills, and leadership development. Students receive personalized academic counseling and career guidance.

religious.heroSubtitle: Nurturing faith, character, and spiritual growth.

overview.title: Our Religious Program
overview.subtitle: Comprehensive Islamic education from the first steps of faith to advanced scholarship.
overview.text: MAHAD Al-TOWHEED offers a dedicated religious education program spanning Grade 1 through Grade 12. Our curriculum is designed to instill deep understanding of Islamic principles, Quranic studies, and moral values that guide students throughout their lives.

levels.title: Program Structure
levels.subtitle: A progressive journey of faith and knowledge.

elementary.title: Elementary Religious
elementary.description: Foundational Islamic education focusing on Quran memorization (Hifz), basic Fiqh, Islamic manners (Adab), and stories of the Prophets. Children learn through interactive lessons, songs, and visual aids.

middle.title: Middle School Religious
middle.description: Intermediate studies in Tafsir, Hadith, Islamic History, and advanced Fiqh. Students begin analytical thinking about Islamic texts and their application in modern life.

advanced.title: Advanced Religious
advanced.description: Advanced scholarship preparation including Usul al-Fiqh, advanced Tafsir, Islamic jurisprudence, and Dawah training. Graduates are prepared for higher Islamic studies or community leadership roles.

curriculum.title: Curriculum Pillars
curriculum.subtitle: The four foundations of our religious program.

items.title: Quranic Studies
items.desc: Tilawah, Hifz, Tafsir, and Tajweed from beginner to advanced levels.

items.title: Hadith & Sunnah
items.desc: Study of authentic narrations, their meanings, and practical applications.

items.title: Fiqh & Worship
items.desc: Understanding Islamic jurisprudence related to prayer, fasting, zakat, and daily life.

items.title: Aqeedah & Character
items.desc: Correct Islamic creed combined with moral and ethical development.

objectives.title: Learning Objectives
objectives.subtitle: What our students achieve.
list: Memorize the entire Juz Amma by Grade 6
Understand the meaning of daily prayers and supplications
Apply Islamic ethics in personal and social life
Develop critical thinking about modern challenges from an Islamic perspective
Prepare for advanced Islamic scholarship or community service

character.text: Beyond academic knowledge, our religious program focuses on Tazkiyah (spiritual purification) and Tarbiah (holistic upbringing). Students participate in daily Dhikr, weekly mentoring sessions, and monthly community service projects that transform knowledge into action.
character.quote: Knowledge without action is like a tree without fruit.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know before applying.

items.question: What is the minimum age for kindergarten?
items.answer: Children must be at least 4 years old by September 1st to enroll in KG1.

items.question: Can my child enroll in both academic and religious programs?
items.answer: Yes. Many of our students are enrolled in both programs. The schedules are designed to accommodate dual enrollment.

items.question: Do you accept students mid-year?
items.answer: Yes, we accept transfers during the first semester (September–November) subject to seat availability and assessment.

items.question: Is there a uniform requirement?
items.answer: Yes. All students wear the school uniform, which is available for purchase at the school office at subsidized prices.

items.question: What languages are used for instruction?
items.answer: Academic subjects are taught in English. Religious studies are taught in Arabic with Amharic explanations where needed.

items.question: How can I apply for financial aid?
items.answer: Indicate your interest on the application form. Our social worker will contact you to schedule a confidential family interview.

items.question: Are meals provided at school?
items.answer: We provide a daily nutritious lunch at a subsidized cost. Students may also bring food from home.

items.question: What is the student-to-teacher ratio?
items.answer: We maintain a ratio of 25 students per teacher to ensure personalized attention.

intro.title: Welcome to MAHAD Al-TOWHEED
intro.subtitle: A place where academic excellence meets moral foundation.
intro.p1: Founded with a vision to serve our community, MAHAD Al-TOWHEED provides comprehensive education from Kindergarten through Grade 10, alongside a dedicated religious education program from Grade 1 through Grade 12.
intro.p2: We believe every child deserves access to quality education that nurtures both the mind and the spirit. Our dedicated teachers, modern facilities, and values-driven curriculum create an environment where students thrive.
intro.p3: As a non-profit institution, we rely on the generosity of donors and partners to continue our mission. Your support directly impacts the lives of children who would otherwise be left behind.
